properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.hosts
properties.description: Nodes of the RabbitMQ Streams event store to connect to first, host or host:port, comma-separated, tried in order (then each stream's leader as the broker advertises it).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.port
properties.description: The port of a host given without one (5552, 5551 with TLS).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.password
properties.description: The stream user's password (default guest); password-file wins over it. Never logged.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.password-file
properties.description: A file holding the stream user's password, trimmed at both ends (an empty one fails the startup); wins over password.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.tls
properties.description: TLS to every node, verified against tls-ca-file (with host name verification).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.tls-ca-file
properties.description: PEM CA certificates the nodes are verified against; required with TLS (the store never connects unverified).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.load-balancer
properties.description: The hosts are a load balancer: connect through it until it lands on the node needed (at most 32 tries).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.offset-store-messages
properties.description: A processor stores its position every so many acknowledgements, or every offset-store-interval, whichever first, and always when a partition moves away and at shutdown.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.offset-store-interval
properties.description: A processor stores its position this often at least (see offset-store-messages).

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.confirm-timeout
properties.description: The longest a publish waits for the broker's confirm; a connection that confirms nothing within it is replaced and the publish retried by the outbox relay.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.management.url
properties.description: The RabbitMQ management API (http(s)://host:port, no credentials in it; plugin rabbitmq_stream_management, metrics collection on): declares the capability replay. Asked once at startup.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.management.username
properties.description: The management API's user; default the stream user.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.management.password
properties.description: The management API's password; default the stream user's. Never logged.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.management.password-file
properties.description: A file holding the management API's password, trimmed at both ends (an empty one fails the startup); wins over management.password.

properties.name: snodra.messaging.rabbitmq.management.ca-file
properties.description: PEM CA certificates of an https management API.
